Generic rearrangement/Gamma tools are explicitly treated as prior knowledge. Unindexed equivalences and unavailable details of a 2023 stability preprint remain priority risks.

value.rationale: The signed energy contrast of two fixed Hermite states is a natural localized-measurement design objective, whose optimal region is not known a priori and need not be connected or radial. The all-degree complete optimizer, sharp small-symmetric-difference coefficient, and fixed-gap versus square-root-gap limiting behavior provide exact quantitative benchmarks and delineate a natural resolution scale. This adds structural and scaling information beyond individual Gamma eigenvalue formulas and classic bathtub rearrangement.
